title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
summary: Robots operating in open environments act under partial observability, physical constraints, and dynamic task contexts. Beyond mapping observations and language instructions to actions, they must anticipate how candidate actions may affect future states and task-relevant outcomes. Recent advances in world models, video generation, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have motivated the development of World-Action Models (WAMs), which couple future world prediction with executable action generation. This survey provides a robotics-oriented review of WAMs. We clarify their scope relative to conventional world models, model-based reinforcement learning, action-conditioned video generation, and reactive VLA policies, and organize existing methods through a unified taxonomy covering representations, transition modeling, action interfaces, architectures, training pipelines, data modalities, and scaling strategies. We further review applications of WAMs in manipulation, navigation, and autonomous driving, and we summarize the datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and protocols used to evaluate WAM systems. Finally, we discuss key challenges in action alignment, world-action factorization, spatial and multi-view consistency, long-horizon memory, neural simulation for closed-loop policy learning, and efficient inference. Taken together, this survey aims to provide a concise technical foundation for integrating predictive world modeling with action generation, toward more reliable embodied robot intelligence. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Awesome-World-Action-Models.
tldr: This survey presents a unified taxonomy and technical foundation for World-Action Models (WAMs), which couple future world prediction with executable action generation for robot learning and control, covering representations, architectures, training, benchmarks, and applications in manipulation, navigation, and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 该综述提出了世界动作模型（WAMs）的统一分类法和技术基础，将未来世界预测与可执行动作生成相结合，涵盖表征、架构、训练、基准以及操作、导航和自动驾驶中的应用。
summary_zh: 在开放环境中运行的机器人在部分可观测性、物理约束和动态任务情境下执行操作。除了将观测信息与语言指令映射为动作之外，它们还必须预测候选动作可能如何影响未来状态以及与任务相关的最终结果。近年来，世界模型、视频生成以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的进展，推动了世界-动作模型（WAMs）的发展，该模型将未来世界预测与可执行动作生成相结合。本综述从机器人学的视角对WAMs进行了系统梳理。我们明确了其相对于传统世界模型、基于模型的强化学习、动作条件下的视频生成以及反应式VLA策略的边界，并通过一个统一的分类体系对现有方法进行归类，涵盖表示形式、状态转移建模、动作接口、网络架构、训练流程、数据模态和扩展策略等方面。我们进一步回顾了WAMs在操作、导航和自动驾驶中的应用，并总结了用于评估WAM系统的数据集、基准、指标和评估协议。最后，我们讨论了动作对齐、世界-动作解耦、空间与多视角一致性、长时程记忆、用于闭环策略学习的神经仿真以及高效推理等关键挑战。总体而言，本综述旨在为将预测性世界建模与动作生成相结合提供简洁的技术基础，以推动更可靠的具身机器人智能的发展。项目主页：https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Awesome-World-Action-Models。

title: VLBiMan++: Expanding the Generalization Boundary of Vision-Language Anchored One-Shot Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Generalizable bimanual robotic manipulation requires a reusable task prior that can persist across increasingly diverse tasks, objects, scenes, embodiments, and execution conditions, thus avoiding the prohibitive cost of large-scale teleoperated demonstrations and policy retraining. In this work, we present VLBiMan++, an extended framework that expands the generalization boundary of vision-language anchored one-shot bimanual manipulation. Starting from a single human demonstration, VLBiMan++ performs task-aware decomposition to identify reusable and adaptable skill components, and employs vision-language grounded geometric adaptation to transfer these skills to novel configurations without retraining. Building on this foundation, we systematically extend generalization along five dimensions: task generalization through diverse and long-horizon skill compositions; object generalization across unseen categories, varying geometries, and more complex articulated or deformable objects; scene generalization under clutter, occlusion, and dynamic interference; embodiment generalization across heterogeneous dual-arm robotic platforms; and deployment generalization through prolonged closed-loop execution under repeated external perturbations. To support this broader scope, we further introduce object-state-aware adaptation and lightweight trajectory optimization mechanisms that accommodate changes beyond simple rigid 6-DoF pose variations while preserving reliable bimanual coordination. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that VLBiMan++ maintains strong task success and adaptation capability across these increasingly challenging settings. Overall, VLBiMan++ advances one-shot bimanual manipulation from demonstrating isolated transferability toward a more systematic and scalable framework for generalization across tasks, objects, scenes, embodiments, and long-term deployment conditions.
tldr: VLBiMan++ extends a vision-language-anchored one-shot bimanual manipulation framework to achieve generalization across tasks, objects, scenes, embodiments, and long-term deployment via task-aware decomposition and geometric adaptation, validated with real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: VLBiMan++ 扩展了基于视觉-语言锚定的单次双臂操作框架，通过任务感知分解和几何适配，在任务、物体、场景、实体和长期部署等方面实现泛化，并经真实世界实验验证。
summary_zh: 通用的双臂机器人操作需要一个可复用的任务先验，使其能够持续适应日益多样化的任务、物体、场景、本体和执行条件，从而避免大规模遥操作示范与策略重训所带来的高昂成本。在本工作中，我们提出了VLBiMan++，一个扩展框架，旨在拓展基于视觉-语言锚定的单次双臂操作泛化边界。从单次人类示范出发，VLBiMan++执行任务感知分解，以识别可复用且可调整的技能组件，并借助视觉-语言驱动的几何适应机制，将这些技能迁移至新配置场景，无需重新训练。在此基础之上，我们系统地沿五个维度拓展泛化能力：通过多样化与长时序技能组合实现任务泛化；跨未见类别、不同几何形态及更复杂的铰接或可变形物体实现物体泛化；在杂乱、遮挡及动态干扰场景中实现场景泛化；跨异构双臂机器人平台实现本体泛化；以及在重复外部扰动下进行长时间闭环执行，实现部署泛化。为支撑上述更广泛的应用范围，我们进一步引入目标状态感知的适应机制与轻量化轨迹优化策略，以应对超越简单刚体六自由度姿态变化的情况，同时保持可靠的双臂协调。大量真实世界实验结果表明，VLBiMan++在逐步递增的挑战性设置下，仍能保持较高的任务成功率与适应能力。总体而言，VLBiMan++将单次双臂操作从展示孤立可迁移性，推进至一个更系统化、可扩展的泛化框架，适用于任务、物体、场景、本体及长期部署条件的广泛变化。

title: Skill Composition for Legged Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Robots, and humanoid robots in particular, are increasingly competent at individual behaviors, each obtained by training a specialized controller. A specialized skill is quick to train, converges reliably because the problem it faces is narrow, and can be validated on its own, none of which is true of a single end-to-end policy asked to cover everything. What remains fragile is the transition between them. We argue that the composition of independent sub-policies deserves to be treated as a research problem in its own right, rather than as an implementation detail left to whatever mechanism happens to be at hand. Reliable composition is what turns a collection of separate skills into a repertoire that can be used, extended and shared. More fundamentally, if control can be passed between specialized policies safely, and at any moment, the choice of what the robot should do next can be delegated to a component of an entirely different nature, such as a planner, an automaton or a symbolic controller, whose behavior can be inspected in advance. The policies would then only ever have to act, and what the robot can be trusted to do would become verifiable.
tldr: This paper argues that the composition of independent sub-policies for legged robot skills should be treated as a research problem in its own right, proposing a framework where safe control handoff between specialized policies enables verifiable and extensible robot behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文主张将腿部机器人独立子策略的组合视为一个独立的研究问题，提出一种在专用策略之间安全传递控制权的框架，以实现可验证和可扩展的机器人行为。
summary_zh: 机器人，尤其是人形机器人，在单项行为能力上日益精进，每项能力均通过训练专用控制器获得。专项技能训练迅速，因其面对的问题范围狭窄而能可靠收敛，并可独立验证，而单一的端到端策略若被要求覆盖所有情形，则无法具备这些特性。然而，各项技能之间的转换仍显脆弱。我们认为，独立子策略的组合本身理应被视作一个研究课题，而非仅作为依赖于手头现有机制的实施细节。可靠的组合能将零散的技能集转化为可用、可扩展、可共享的技能库。更根本的是，若控制能在专用策略间安全传递，且可在任意时刻进行，那么机器人下一步行动的选择便可交由性质完全不同的组件，如规划器、自动机或符号控制器，其行为可预先审查。如此，策略便只需负责执行，而机器人可被信赖的行为范围也将变得可验证。

title: REVOLVE: An Automated Closed-Loop Framework for Evolving Robot Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
summary: Recent advances in data-driven robot manipulation policies have substantially improved task execution and generalization. However, real-world deployment still relies heavily on humans for failure assessment, correction, and environment reset, while models often fail to continually learn from failures and corrective experience. We present REVOLVE (Robot Evolving via Orchestrated Loops, Verification, and Experience), an automated closed-loop framework for evolving robot manipulation with minimal human intervention. Built on a unified software platform, REVOLVE integrates data collection, policy training and deployment, failure recovery, and continual learning into a single closed-loop workflow. Its Automated Reset and Collection (ARC) architecture automatically resets the environment and intervenes to correct policy failures. Dual-Loop Evolution (DLE) continually improves the manipulation policy and agent by feeding real-world interaction and failure--correction data back into policy learning and using an external mismatch memory to refine agent judgments. Experiments across four real-world manipulation tasks show that, after five iterations, REVOLVE improves average policy success rate by 18.5% and agent judgment accuracy by 8.5%, while reducing human effort in data collection and deployment testing by 94.4% and 95.1%, respectively. These results demonstrate that REVOLVE transforms real-world deployment into a closed-loop learning process that continually accumulates and uses execution experience, enabling continual evolution of both the policy and supervisory model with substantially less human intervention.
tldr: REVOLVE presents an automated closed-loop framework that integrates data collection, policy training, failure recovery, and continual learning for robot manipulation, improving success rates and reducing human intervention across real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: REVOLVE 提出了一个自动化闭环框架，将数据收集、策略训练、失败恢复和持续学习整合到机器人操作中，在真实任务中提高了成功率并减少了人工干预。
summary_zh: 数据驱动的机器人操作策略的最新进展显著提升了任务执行能力和泛化性能。然而，实际部署仍然严重依赖人工进行失败评估、纠正和环境重置，而模型往往无法从失败和纠正性经验中持续学习。我们提出了REVOLVE（通过编排循环、验证和经验实现机器人进化），一种自动化闭环框架，用于以最少的人工干预实现机器人操作的持续进化。基于统一软件平台，REVOLVE将数据采集、策略训练与部署、失败恢复和持续学习整合为一个闭环工作流。其自动重置与采集（ARC）架构能够自动重置环境并干预纠正策略失败。双环进化（DLE）通过将真实世界交互和失败-纠正数据反馈到策略学习中，并利用外部失配记忆优化智能体判断，持续改进操作策略和智能体。在四个真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，经过五次迭代后，REVOLVE将平均策略成功率提升了18.5%，智能体判断准确率提升了8.5%，同时将数据采集和部署测试中的人工投入分别减少了94.4%和95.1%。这些结果表明，REVOLVE将实际部署转化为一个持续积累和利用执行经验的闭环学习过程，使策略和监督模型能够在显著减少人工干预的情况下实现持续进化。

title: EMoG: Emotion-Modulated Gait Generation for Expressive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Existing humanoid locomotion systems primarily focus on stability and task execution, while integrating expressiveness with explicit locomotion control remains challenging. We propose EMoG, an emotion-modulated gait generation framework for expressive humanoid locomotion. EMoG introduces an emotional-style code with continuously adjustable intensity. Conditioned on this code and physical commands, a lightweight MLP generates expressive, command-consistent periodic gait trajectories in real time, which are tracked by a unified reinforcement learning policy for physical execution. To support training, we collect a large-scale emotion-annotated gait dataset from professional performers and develop an automated pipeline to extract physically consistent periodic gait cycles. EMoG also integrates an LLM-based parser that converts free-form language into emotional style and motion parameters for interactive control. Experiments demonstrate continuous gait-style modulation with perceptible expressive cues while maintaining command tracking. EMoG provides a practical approach to parameterized emotional-style walking for human-robot interaction.
tldr: EMoG proposes a reinforcement learning-based framework for generating emotion-modulated gait trajectories in humanoid robots, controlled by an emotional-style code and free-form language via an LLM parser, enabling expressive locomotion with continuous intensity adjustment.
tldr_zh: EMoG提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，用于生成人形机器人的情感调制步态轨迹，通过情感风格代码和LLM解析器实现自由语言控制，支持连续强度的情感表达和命令跟踪。
summary_zh: 现有人形机器人的运动系统主要关注稳定性与任务执行能力，而如何在显式运动控制中融入表现力仍是一个挑战。我们提出了EMoG，一种面向富有表现力的人形运动的情感调制步态生成框架。EMoG引入了一种具有连续可调强度的情感风格编码。在该编码及物理指令的共同条件下，一个轻量级MLP能够实时生成具有表现力且与指令一致的周期性步态轨迹，并由统一强化学习策略进行物理执行。为支持训练，我们收集了由专业表演者标注的大规模情感步态数据集，并开发了一条自动化流程，用以提取物理一致的周期性步态。EMoG还集成了一个基于大语言模型的解析器，可将自然语言输入转换为情感风格与运动参数，从而实现交互式控制。实验表明，该系统在保持指令跟踪能力的同时，实现了具有可感知表现力线索的连续步态风格调制。EMoG为参数化情感风格行走在人机交互中的应用提供了一种可行方案。

title: BIG-CBF: Behavior-Imagination-Guided Control Barrier Function with Shared Uncertainty for Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a mathematically grounded framework for enforcing local collision-avoidance constraints in autonomous mobile robots, commonly through optimization-based safety filters. However, a minimum-intervention CBF filter lacks task-level maneuver awareness and may fail to select a productive avoidance direction when multiple distinct maneuvers are locally viable, leading to safe but stalled behavior in geometrically ambiguous environments. This paper presents BIG-CBF, Behavior-Imagination-Guided Control Barrier Function with shared uncertainty, a two-rate navigation architecture that separates low-rate maneuver selection from high-rate safety filtering. Over a short horizon, six closed-loop feedback behaviors are imagined and evaluated using analytic CBF compatibility together with a lightweight objective accounting for task progress, freezing, smoothness, and switching. To reduce planning-execution mismatch, the imagination and execution layers share consistent uncertainty sources for relative-motion delay, obstacle prediction, zero-order-hold motion, and command-execution residuals, while a hard CBF remains the final safety authority. In a 3,600-episode comparative benchmark across nine scenarios, BIG-CBF achieves the highest overall task success rate of 99.78% while substantially reducing downstream CBF intervention. On a physical omnidirectional robot with onboard Jetson Orin Nano computation, BIG-CBF completes all 15 evaluation runs without a recorded contact event. Matched hardware comparisons against the non-shared variant further show lower CBF intervention energy and activation frequency, supporting improved consistency between maneuver selection and safety-critical execution.
tldr: BIG-CBF introduces a two-rate navigation architecture that combines behavior imagination with control barrier functions and shared uncertainty to improve maneuver selection and safety execution for mobile robots, achieving high success rates on real hardware.
tldr_zh: BIG-CBF 提出了一种双速率导航架构，将行为想象与控制屏障函数及共享不确定性相结合，以改进移动机器人的机动选择和安全执行，在真实硬件上实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 控制屏障函数（CBFs）为自主移动机器人中的局部避碰约束提供了一个数学上严谨的框架，通常通过基于优化的安全滤波器实现。然而，最小干预的CBF滤波器缺乏任务层面的机动感知能力，当多个不同机动在局部均可行时，可能无法选择有效的避让方向，从而在几何模糊环境中导致安全但停滞的行为。本文提出BIG-CBF——具有共享不确定性的行为想象引导控制屏障函数，这是一种双速率导航架构，将低速率机动选择与高速率安全滤波分离。在短时间范围内，通过解析CBF兼容性以及综合考虑任务进展、冻结、平滑性和切换的轻量级目标函数，对六种闭环反馈行为进行想象和评估。为减少规划与执行之间的失配，想象层与执行层共享一致的不确定性来源，包括相对运动延迟、障碍物预测、零阶保持运动和指令执行残差，同时硬CBF仍作为最终安全权威。在涵盖九个场景的3，600个回合对比基准测试中，BIG-CBF实现了99.78%的最高总体任务成功率，同时显著减少了下游CBF干预。在搭载板载Jetson Orin Nano计算平台的物理全向机器人上，BIG-CBF完成了全部15次评估实验，未记录到任何接触事件。与不共享不确定性变量的变体进行硬件匹配对比，进一步表明BIG-CBF具有更低的CBF干预能量和激活频率，验证了机动选择与安全关键执行之间一致性的改善。

title: Learning Communication-Conditioned Generative Policies for Decentralized Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance
summary: In this work, we propose a decentralized communication-conditioned generative framework for multi-agent collision avoidance. Agents generate short-horizon action sequences using a flow-matching policy trained from privileged offline demonstrations with access to global state. The demonstrations do not include explicit communication signals; instead, agents learn to exchange and aggregate latent messages that encode interaction-relevant intent under partial observability. This formulation supports flexible inference at test time, where unconditioned generation corresponds to independent behavior and communication-conditioned generation enables coordinated interaction without centralized planning. The resulting policies operate in a fully decentralized manner at execution time, relying only on local observations and learned messages. Combined with a receding-horizon inference scheme, the proposed approach enables efficient single-step inference of short-horizon action sequences and degrades gracefully under communication dropouts. Extensive simulation results demonstrate near-expert collision avoidance performance and strong generalization to denser, unseen multi-agent scenarios, along with zero-shot transfer to real-robot experiments.
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized communication-conditioned generative framework using flow-matching policies for multi-agent collision avoidance, trained from privileged demonstrations and enabling zero-shot transfer to real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于流匹配策略的去中心化通信条件生成框架，用于多智能体碰撞避免，通过特权示范训练，并实现零样本迁移至真实机器人。
summary_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向多智能体碰撞避免的去中心化通信条件生成框架。智能体利用从具有全局状态访问权限的特权离线演示中训练得到的流匹配策略，生成短时域动作序列。演示中并不包含显式的通信信号；相反，智能体学习在部分可观测条件下交换并聚合编码交互相关意图的潜在消息。该框架支持测试时的灵活推理，其中无条件生成对应独立行为，而通信条件生成则能够在无需集中式规划的情况下实现协调交互。所得到的策略在执行时以完全去中心化的方式运行，仅依赖局部观测和学习到的消息。结合滚动时域推理方案，所提出的方法能够实现对短时域动作序列的高效单步推理，并在通信中断情况下实现优雅降级。大量仿真结果表明，该方法具有接近专家的避碰性能，并能强泛化到更密集、未见过的多智能体场景，同时支持零样本迁移至真实机器人实验。

title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
summary: Recent robot learning paradigms increasingly rely on large offline datasets of robotic interactions to train control policies. Expressive generative models enable rich and multimodal action representations, expanding the capability of this paradigm for complex robotic control. However, policy improvement with multi-step generative actors remains challenging. In offline reinforcement learning (RL), incorporating value-based objectives along generative trajectories often introduces substantial training complexity, including backpropagation through time (BPTT), auxiliary architectures, or distillation losses. We propose Value-Guided Flow Matching (VGFM), a scalable offline RL framework that enables dense value-guided shaping within a flow-based policy while avoiding BPTT and additional algorithmic overhead. VGFM parameterizes the policy as a conditional flow-matching model in action (x-prediction) space, ensuring that each intermediate flow step produces a valid robot action that can be directly evaluated by a standard offline RL critic. This design allows value guidance to be applied at randomly sampled flow times without differentiating through the entire generative trajectory, while preserving inference-time flexibility by varying the discretization of the underlying flow ODE without retraining. Evaluated on robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks in OGBench, VGFM achieves strong performance across a wide range of tasks under rigorous evaluation protocols. With minimal hyperparameter tuning, these results demonstrate that VGFM provides a simple, scalable, and effective approach for expressive policy learning in long-horizon, goal-oriented robotic control.
tldr: This paper introduces Value-Guided Flow Matching (VGFM), an offline RL framework that integrates dense value guidance into flow-based robot policies without backpropagation through time, achieving strong performance on OGBench tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了价值引导流匹配（VGFM），一种离线强化学习框架，在不使用时间反向传播的情况下将密集价值引导集成到基于流的机器人策略中，在OGBench任务上取得了优异性能。
summary_zh: 近年来，机器人学习范式越来越依赖于大规模离线机器人交互数据集来训练控制策略。表达能力强的生成模型能够实现丰富且多模态的动作表示，从而扩展了该范式在复杂机器人控制中的能力。然而，使用多步生成式智能体进行策略改进仍然具有挑战性。在离线强化学习（RL）中，沿生成轨迹引入基于价值的优化目标通常会带来大量训练复杂性，包括时间反向传播（BPTT）、辅助架构或蒸馏损失。我们提出价值引导流匹配（VGFM），一种可扩展的离线强化学习框架，能够在基于流的策略中实现密集的价值引导塑形，同时避免BPTT和额外算法开销。VGFM将策略参数化为动作（x预测）空间中的条件流匹配模型，确保每个中间流步骤都产生有效的机器人动作，可直接由标准离线强化学习评论家进行评估。该设计允许在随机采样的流时间点应用价值引导，而无需对整个生成轨迹进行微分，同时通过改变底层流常微分方程的离散化方式，在不重新训练的情况下保留推理时的灵活性。在OGBench中的机器人运动与操作任务评估中，VGFM在严格的评估协议下于广泛任务中取得了强劲性能。在极少的超参数调优下，这些结果表明VGFM为长时域、目标导向的机器人控制中的表达性策略学习提供了一种简单、可扩展且有效的方法。

title: GIFT: Glove-Inferred Force Transfer: Force-Aware Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer from a Wearable Sensing Glove to a Robot Hand Without Tactile Sensors
summary: Human-to-robot skill transfer from sensing gloves has so far relied on shared hardware: the same tactile glove worn by the demonstrator and the robot, or a learned alignment between two tactile sensors. We present GIFT (Glove-Inferred Force Transfer), a pipeline in which the interface between human and robot is a physical unit rather than a shared sensor: fingertip force is measured in newtons on the human side and estimated in newtons on the robot side. A wearable glove records finger flexion, calibrated fingertip force, and wrist orientation, while a head-mounted camera records the demonstration; no robot is present. At deployment, the robot estimates force from actuator-current residuals relative to a free-space baseline, through a calibrated mapping to newtons, so any position-controlled hand that reports motor current can serve as the deployment platform. The policy uses a glove-space state and predicts finger-position targets; the robot enters only through two calibrated adapters, a retargeting decoder and a force estimator. We evaluate GIFT on a cup grasp-and-hold task with two action-chunking policies trained on the same demonstrations, with fingertip-force inputs retained in one and zeroed in the other. In a 50-rollout evaluation with sample size and metrics fixed before scoring, both policies succeeded in all 25 rollouts. The median of the per-rollout hold-phase grip-force estimates was 53% lower with force inputs: 1.20 N versus 2.55 N (one-sided Mann-Whitney U, p<0.0001). In an observation ablation, a vision-only policy achieved 0/15 grasps, policies given hand-command state acquired the grasp, and the force inputs determined how hard the policy held. A force channel measured on the human hand thus transfers to a robot hand with no tactile hardware, through a retargeting map from five glove channels to seven robot actuators, with no sensor shared between the two.
tldr: GIFT transfers human grasping skills to a robot hand by measuring fingertip forces with a wearable glove and estimating forces on the robot from motor-current residuals, eliminating the need for tactile sensors on the robot.
tldr_zh: GIFT通过可穿戴手套测量人类指尖力，并在机器人侧通过电机电流残差估算力，从而将人类抓取技能迁移到机器人手，无需机器人侧触觉传感器。
summary_zh: 人手到机器人的技能迁移以往依赖于共享硬件：演示者与机器人佩戴相同的触觉手套，或通过习得的对齐映射来关联两种触觉传感器。本文提出GIFT（手套推断力传递）流程，其中人与机器人之间的接口是一个物理单元，而非共享传感器：人手侧以牛顿为单位测量指尖力，机器人侧同样以牛顿为单位估计指尖力。可穿戴手套记录手指弯曲角度、标定后的指尖力及手腕姿态，同时头戴摄像头记录演示过程；此阶段无需机器人参与。部署时，机器人通过相较于自由空间基线的执行器电流残差估计力，并经由标定映射转换为牛顿单位，因此任何能报告电机电流的位置控制手爪均可作为部署平台。策略使用手套空间状态并预测手指位置目标；机器人仅通过两个标定适配器接入，即重定向解码器和力估计器。我们在一个杯子抓取与保持任务上评估GIFT，训练了两个基于相同演示的动作分块策略，其中一个保留指尖力输入，另一个将其置零。在样本量和指标预先确定的50次 rollout 评估中，两个策略在所有25次 rollout 中均成功。含力输入策略的每次 rollout 保持阶段抓握力估计中位数比无力输入策略低53%：1.20 N对2.55 N（单侧Mann-Whitney U检验，p<0.0001）。在观察消融实验中，仅视觉策略实现0/15次抓取，给定手部命令状态的策略习得抓取动作，而力输入决定了策略的抓握力度。因此，在人手上测量的力通道无需任何触觉硬件即可迁移至机器人手，仅通过从五个手套通道到七个机器人执行器的重定向映射实现，双方无需共享任何传感器。

title: Visible Touch: Rendering Contact for Visuomotor Policies
summary: Integrating contact information into visuomotor policies remains an open problem. Touch is essential to robust manipulation, yet most modern policies, including pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models, operate from vision and proprioception alone. Existing approaches to closing this gap require specialized tactile hardware, add separate tactile encoders, or commit to non-image policy backbones, all incompatible with the modern paradigm of image-conditioned policies built on pretrained 2D visual representations. Our key insight is that the bottleneck is not the contact information itself, but how it is delivered: when contact signals are exposed in the same spatial frame as the scene the policy already attends to, they become directly usable by any image-conditioned policy without architectural changes. We operationalize this insight in Visible Touch, paired with a custom low-cost magnetic contact sensor that is open-sourced and fabricated from off-the-shelf parts via a parametric CAD-to-mold pipeline. Across the LIBERO benchmark, Visible Touch improves BC-Transformer success by 15.7 percentage points on average in the 2-view setting, with similar gains in the 1-view setting; controlled comparisons show that the contact-integration strategy strongly affects how effectively tactile information is used. The pattern holds when fine-tuning pretrained VLAs: miniVLA on LIBERO gains 25 percentage points on average, and $π_{0.5}$ on four real-world contact-rich tasks gains 30 percentage points with our custom sensor.
tldr: Visible Touch introduces a method to render contact information as images aligned with the visual scene, enabling any image-conditioned visuomotor policy, including VLAs, to leverage tactile data without architectural changes. It includes an open-source low-cost magnetic contact sensor and demonstrates significant success-rate improvements on LIBERO benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: Visible Touch 提出了一种将接触信息渲染为与视觉场景对齐的图像的方法，使得包括 VLA 在内的任何基于图像的视觉运动策略无需修改架构即可利用触觉数据。该方法包含一个开源的低成本磁性接触传感器，并在 LIBERO 基准和真实世界任务中显著提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：将接触信息整合到视觉运动策略中仍是一个开放性问题。触觉对于鲁棒操作至关重要，然而大多数现代策略，包括预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，仅依赖视觉和本体感觉进行运作。现有弥合这一差距的方法需要专门的触觉硬件、添加独立的触觉编码器，或采用非图像策略主干，这些都与基于预训练二维视觉表征的图像条件策略的现代范式不兼容。我们的关键见解在于，瓶颈并非接触信息本身，而是其传递方式：当接触信号以策略已关注的场景的同一空间框架呈现时，它们无需架构变更即可直接被任何图像条件策略使用。我们通过Visible Touch实现了这一见解，并配备了一款定制的低成本磁力接触传感器，该传感器为开源设计，并通过参数化CAD-to-mold流程由现成部件制造。在LIBERO基准测试中，Visible Touch在双视角设置下将BC-Transformer的成功率平均提升了15.7个百分点，在单视角设置下也取得了相近的提升；对照比较表明，接触整合策略对触觉信息的有效利用程度影响显著。该模式在微调预训练VLA时同样成立：miniVLA在LIBERO上平均提升25个百分点，而使用我们定制传感器的π₀.₅在四项真实世界接触密集型任务上平均提升30个百分点。

title: When Faster VLA Deployment Changes Closed-Loop Behavior: Task Success-Latency Analysis of SmolVLA Across PyTorch and ONNX Variants
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) deployment can reduce inference latency while changing closed-loop task behavior. We evaluate HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero on an RTX 2060 (6 GB) in LIBERO Spatial and Object (MuJoCo 3.3.2, LeRobot 0.6.1, seed 42), comparing PyTorch+AMP with ONNX Runtime CUDA Execution Provider (CUDA EP). The main evaluation uses 100 episodes/suite; a paired rollout uses 300 episodes/suite. PyTorch+AMP reaches 70.0%/88.0% Spatial/Object success at 1181 ms p99. Requested-FP16 and requested-INT8 ONNX reduce tether-inspect p99 to 601 ms and 532 ms, while Spatial success falls to 41.0% and 40.0% and Object remains at 89.0%. A graph audit shows those artifacts are byte-identical FP32 graphs, so the requested-INT8 row is not operator-level INT8 quantization. A static language-width ablation (16/24/32 tokens) yields Spatial success of 41.0%, 75.0%, and 71.0%; widths 24 and 32 recover much of the Spatial drop while Object success and uniform-bench latency stay approximately stable. Width-24 ONNX Spatial success is comparable to the PyTorch+AMP baseline at roughly half the latency (Wilson intervals overlap; two-proportion chi-squared p=0.53). Context width is an important contributor in this stack; it does not account for every PyTorch-vs-ONNX difference. Deployment evaluation should jointly report latency, artifact inspection, interface constraints, and closed-loop success. Code: https://github.com/rafiqul713/smolvla-libero-onnx.
tldr: This paper analyzes how deploying SmolVLA on different runtime and precision backends (PyTorch vs ONNX) affects closed-loop LIBERO task success and latency, finding that requested INT8 artifacts were actually FP32 and that a shorter language context width was a key factor in performance degradation but not the sole cause. It calls for deployment evaluation to jointly report latency, artifact inspection, interface constraints, and closed-loop success.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了在不同运行时和精度后端（PyTorch vs ONNX）上部署SmolVLA如何影响LIBERO闭环任务成功率与延迟，发现请求的INT8模型实为FP32，而较短的上下文宽度是关键性能影响因素但非唯一原因，并呼吁部署评估应联合报告延迟、模型检查、接口约束和闭环成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型部署可在降低推理延迟的同时改变闭环任务行为。我们在RTX 2060（6 GB）上，基于LIBERO Spatial和Object基准（MuJoCo 3.3.2，LeRobot 0.6.1，随机种子42），评估了HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero模型，并对比了PyTorch+AMP与ONNX Runtime CUDA执行提供程序（CUDA EP）两种推理方案。主评估每个任务套件运行100个回合；配对测试运行300个回合/套件。PyTorch+AMP在1181毫秒p99延迟下达到Spatial 70.0%和Object 88.0%的成功率。请求的FP16与INT8 ONNX版本将tether-inspect p99延迟分别降至601毫秒和532毫秒，但Spatial成功率分别降至41.0%和40.0%，而Object成功率保持在89.0%。图审计显示，这些产物为字节级相同的FP32计算图，因此请求的INT8行并非算子级INT8量化。静态语言宽度消融实验（16/24/32个token）得到的Spatial成功率分别为41.0%、75.0%和71.0%；宽度为24和32时，可大幅恢复Spatial性能下降，而Object成功率和统一基准延迟基本保持稳定。宽度为24的ONNX在Spatial成功率上与PyTorch+AMP基线相当，且延迟约为其一半（Wilson区间重叠；双比例卡方检验p=0.53）。上下文宽度是该技术栈中的一个重要影响因素，但并不能解释PyTorch与ONNX之间的全部差异。部署评估应同时报告延迟、工件检查、接口约束和闭环成功率。代码：https://github.com/rafiqul713/smolvla-libero-onnx。

title: Vision-Force Admittance Learning for Peg Insertion into a Movable Hole
summary: Precise manipulation in dynamic environments, whether induced by a mobile robot base or a target with unknown motion, remains a major challenge in robotics. Manipulation in dynamic environments introduces substantial uncertainty, which fundamentally conflicts with the tight precision requirement of precise tasks such as peg-in-the-hole. We propose a Vision-Force Admittance Learning (VFAL) framework that fuses asynchronous visual feedback with a high-frequency force-based model, using visual pose estimations as a regularization term. VFAL adapts insertion strategies online to dynamic motion while maintaining millimeter-level precision. To obtain robust, low-frequency pose information, we employ state-of-the-art vision foundation models for visual pose estimation. Additionally, we incorporate failure recovery mechanisms to enhance overall robustness. We validate our approach in real-world experiments, demonstrating high success rates and strong adaptability to various pegs and dynamic environments.
tldr: This paper introduces VFAL, a vision-force admittance learning framework that combines asynchronous visual pose estimation with high-frequency force-based control for precise peg-in-hole insertion in dynamic environments. It uses vision foundation models for robust pose estimation and includes failure recovery, validated with real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VFAL框架，融合异步视觉位姿估计与高频力控，实现动态环境中毫米级精度的插孔任务，并通过视觉基础模型和故障恢复机制提升鲁棒性，在真实实验中验证了高成功率。
summary_zh: 在动态环境中进行精密操作，无论是由于移动机器人基座引起的还是目标物体具有未知运动，始终是机器人技术中的一项重大挑战。动态环境下的操作引入了大量不确定性，这与诸如轴孔装配等精密任务所要求的严格精度本质上相悖。我们提出了一种视觉-力觉导纳学习（VFAL）框架，该框架将异步视觉反馈与高频基于力的模型相融合，利用视觉姿态估计作为正则化项。VFAL能够在线调整插入策略以适应动态运动，同时保持毫米级精度。为了获得鲁棒、低频的位姿信息，我们采用了最先进的视觉基础模型进行视觉姿态估计。此外，我们结合了故障恢复机制以增强整体鲁棒性。我们在实际实验中验证了该方法，展示了其在不同销钉及动态环境下的高成功率和强适应性。

title: Diffusion-Based Generation of Gait Trajectories
summary: Generation of musculoskeletal gait trajectories conditioned on patient-specific parameters remains a key challenge for wearable robotics and rehabilitation. Assistive systems such as lower-limb exoskeletons require reference trajectories that adapt to individual morphology and therapeutic goals while preserving biomechanical realism. Traditional approaches rely on hand-crafted gait templates or optimization procedures that scale poorly across subjects and walking conditions. In this work, we explore conditional diffusion models for generating lower-limb joint-angle trajectories conditioned on gait parameters such as step length. We compare a baseline transformer diffusion model with a controllable diffusion transformer variant incorporating adaptive normalization and classifier-free guidance. Experiments on a dataset of 4,590 gait cycles show that diffusion models can generate realistic periodic gait trajectories while enabling some controllability variation in gait characteristics, highlighting their potential for personalized gait synthesis in assistive robotics.
tldr: This paper explores conditional diffusion models for generating personalized lower-limb gait trajectories conditioned on parameters like step length, showing potential for assistive robotics applications.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了基于条件扩散模型生成个性化下肢步态轨迹的方法，以步长等参数为条件，展示了在辅助机器人领域的应用潜力。
summary_zh: 生成与患者特定参数相关的肌肉骨骼步态轨迹，仍是可穿戴机器人和康复领域的一项关键挑战。下肢外骨骼等辅助系统需要参考轨迹，这些轨迹需适应个体形态和治疗目标，同时保持生物力学上的真实性。传统方法依赖于手工设计的步态模板或优化程序，这些方法在跨受试者和不同行走条件下的扩展性较差。在本研究中，我们探索了条件扩散模型，用于生成以步长等步态参数为条件的下肢关节角度轨迹。我们将一个基线Transformer扩散模型与一个结合自适应归一化和无分类器引导的可控扩散Transformer变体进行了比较。在包含4,590个步态周期的数据集上进行的实验表明，扩散模型能够生成逼真的周期性步态轨迹，同时实现对步态特征的一定可控变化，这突显了其在辅助机器人中用于个性化步态合成的潜力。

title: Robotic Servo Tracking of Moving Targets with Dynamic Imitation Constraints
summary: Imposing explicit trajectory constraints in robot visual servoing remains challenging. Existing tracking methods achieve fast responses by mapping visual residuals to control velocities, but they have weak constraints on the intermediate motion process, which lead to trajectory discontinuity, oscillation, or conservative behaviors. To enable constrained tracking for moving targets, this paper proposes a servo tracking method based on imitation trajectory constraints. A dynamic model describing the robot approaching a moving target is formulated and analyzed for convergence. A time-scalable deformation mechanism and a trajectory modulation incorporating shape and amplitude components are introduced to generate a series of trajectories in real time, from which tracking points are adaptively determined to form dynamic constraints. The robot velocity is then computed from target pose differentials or tracked key features to follow the constrained trajectory. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve dynamic obstacle avoidance and high-precision convergence compared with several state-of-the-art methods in complex environments.
tldr: This paper proposes a robotic visual servoing method for tracking moving targets that introduces time-scalable deformation and trajectory modulation to generate dynamic imitation constraints, achieving high-precision convergence and obstacle avoidance. The method is validated in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于动态模仿约束的移动目标机器人视觉伺服跟踪方法，通过时间可伸缩变形和轨迹调制生成实时轨迹约束，在仿真和真实实验中实现了高精度收敛和动态避障。
summary_zh: 在机器人视觉伺服控制中施加显式轨迹约束仍然具有挑战性。现有跟踪方法通过将视觉残差映射为控制速度来实现快速响应，但对中间运动过程的约束较弱，导致轨迹不连续、振荡或行为保守。为实现对移动目标的约束跟踪，本文提出一种基于模仿轨迹约束的伺服跟踪方法。首先构建并分析了描述机器人接近移动目标的动力学模型的收敛性。引入时间可缩放变形机制以及融合形状与幅度分量的轨迹调制方法，实时生成一系列轨迹，并从中自适应确定跟踪点以形成动态约束。随后，根据目标位姿差分或跟踪的关键特征计算机器人速度，以遵循受约束的轨迹。仿真与实物实验表明，与多种最新方法相比，所提方法在复杂环境中能够实现动态避障和高精度收敛。

title: Learning Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Navigation in the Factory: from Simulation to Real Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown considerable promise for robotic decision-making, yet deploying multi-agent RL (MARL) on physical multi-robot systems in industrial environments remains challenging. This paper investigates the real-world applicability of decentralized MARL for multi-robot multi-machine tending. We propose Feature-fusion Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (FMAPPO), which fuses 2D LiDAR measurements with task-specific state information to enable safe decentralized multi-robot task assignment and navigation. A complete simulation-to-reality pipeline was developed using high-fidelity robotic simulation and ROS2 and deployed on physical mobile-manipulator platforms operating under realistic real-world conditions, with the robotic arms disabled during the experiments. We further investigate the sensitivity of the learned policy to command update frequency, an important consideration for real-world deployment. Comparative evaluation in simulation demonstrated that FMAPPO significantly outperformed state-of-the-art baselines with a large effect size, achieving improvements of 106\% and 21\% in parts delivery and 48\% and 11\% in parts collection over MAPPO and SMAPPO, respectively. FMAPPO also increased machine utilization by 31 and 10 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions by 18\% and 15\% and increasing the safety score by 14 and 6 percentage points compared with MAPPO and SMAPPO, respectively. Furthermore, real-world experiments demonstrated that the learned decentralized policies can coordinate multiple robots to service multiple machines while maintaining safe operation under real-world sensing and control constraints. Videos of the real-world experiment are available online https://anonymouspapers123.github.io/FMAPPO/.
tldr: This paper proposes FMAPPO, a decentralized MARL algorithm fusing 2D LiDAR with task-specific states for multi-robot task assignment and navigation in industrial factories, and demonstrates successful sim-to-real transfer on physical mobile manipulators.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了FMAPPO，一种融合2D激光雷达与任务状态信息的去中心化多智能体强化学习算法，用于工厂中的多机器人任务分配与导航，并在实体移动操作平台上实现了成功的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 强化学习在机器人决策方面展现出了巨大潜力，然而，将多智能体强化学习部署到工业环境中的物理多机器人系统仍然充满挑战。本文研究了去中心化多智能体强化学习在多机器人多机床看护任务中的实际应用可行性。我们提出了特征融合多智能体近端策略优化算法，该算法融合二维激光雷达测量数据与任务特定状态信息，以实现安全的多机器人去中心化任务分配与导航。我们利用高保真机器人仿真和ROS2构建了一套完整的仿真到现实迁移流程，并将其部署于真实工况条件下的物理移动机械臂平台上，在实验过程中机械臂处于关闭状态。我们进一步探究了所学策略对命令更新频率的敏感性，这是实际部署中需考虑的一个重要因素。仿真对比评估表明，与传统近端策略优化算法和状态感知多智能体近端策略优化算法相比，系统在零件配送方面分别提升了106%和21%，在零件收集方面分别提升了48%和11%。同时，算法使机器利用率分别提高了31个百分点和10个百分点，碰撞率分别降低了18%和15%，安全评分分别提升了14个百分点和6个百分点。此外，真实世界实验表明，所学的去中心化策略能够在现实传感与控制约束下协调多台机器人为多台机床服务，同时保持安全运行。真实实验视频可在 https://anonymouspapers123.github.io/FMAPPO/ 在线观看。

title: GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation
summary: Active exploration and semantic navigation require an embodied agent to build memory from partial observations, predict how the evolution of observed spatial memory may support future motion, and convert that prediction into actionable plans. We present GLAM, a goal-conditioned latent world model trained over global spatiotemporal memory, and GLAM NAV, the complete navigation system built around it. Given historical map tokens, a navigation goal, and the current robot pose, GLAM jointly predicts future map representations and robot-centric waypoint latents, allowing future spatial context and navigation intent to be inferred in a shared representation space. The model follows a JEPA-like latent prediction paradigm, operates directly on map-level latent tokens rather than RGB reconstruction, and uses a pretrained waypoint encoder-decoder to supervise and decode navigation plans within GLAM NAV. Training data are collected by replaying ObjectNav expert trajectories in Habitat over HM3D v0.2 scene assets and slicing them into multi-timescale prediction samples. On a controlled HM3D-ObjectNav subset reproduction setting, GLAM NAV improves over a reproduced BSC-Nav baseline in both success rate and success weighted by path length.
tldr: GLAM introduces a JEPA-style latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and semantic navigation, jointly predicting future map tokens and waypoint latents to improve ObjectNav success rates in Habitat.
tldr_zh: GLAM 提出了一种基于全局时空记忆的 JEPA 式潜世界模型，用于主动探索和语义导航，通过联合预测未来地图令牌和航点潜变量，提升了 Habitat 中 ObjectNav 的成功率。
summary_zh: 主动探索和语义导航要求具身智能体从局部观测中构建记忆，预测观测到的空间记忆的演化如何支持未来的运动，并将该预测转化为可执行的规划。我们提出了GLAM——一种在全局时空记忆上训练的目标条件潜在世界模型，以及GLAM NAV——围绕该模型构建的完整导航系统。给定历史地图令牌、导航目标和当前机器人位姿，GLAM联合预测未来地图表示和以机器人为中心的路点潜在变量，从而在共享表示空间内同时推断未来空间上下文和导航意图。该模型遵循类似JEPA的潜在预测范式，直接对地图级潜在令牌进行操作而非RGB重建，并使用预训练的路点编码器-解码器在GLAM NAV中监督并解码导航规划。训练数据通过回放在Habitat中基于HM3D v0.2场景资产的ObjectNav专家轨迹，并将其切分为多时间尺度预测样本而获得。在受控的HM3D-ObjectNav子集复现设置中，GLAM NAV在成功率以及按路径长度加权的成功率两项指标上均优于复现的BSC-Nav基线。

title: NavPatch: Evidence-Guided Object-Level Costmap Correction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Mobile robots typically rely on geometric maps for obstacle avoidance and path planning, but the resulting obstacle representation does not always match how an object should affect navigation. A low lying cable may be missed, a flexible curtain may create spurious blockage, and a traffic cone may require an exclusion region larger than its observed footprint. We present NavPatch, an object level correction layer that assigns ADD, REMOVE, or EXTEND to navigation relevant object categories through periodic scene understanding with a vision-language model. Open vocabulary grounding localizes object instances, and LiDAR and RGB-D observations provide 3D support. Observation quality filtering and cross frame maintenance determine when each correction patch is committed, replaced, or revoked. In 50 real robot trials across five layouts, NavPatch achieves an overall success rate of 86.0%. An ablation study of four configurations with 200 runs in total shows that NavPatch improves the success rate from 70.0% to 86.0% and reduces the false commit rate from 68.4% to 40.7% compared with updates based only on the current observation.
tldr: NavPatch is an object-level costmap correction layer using vision-language models that assigns ADD, REMOVE, or EXTEND to navigation-relevant objects, improving robot navigation success in real trials by correcting geometric map inaccuracies.
tldr_zh: NavPatch 是一个基于视觉语言模型的对象级代价地图修正层，通过对导航相关对象分配 ADD、REMOVE 或 EXTEND 操作，在实际试验中提高了机器人导航的成功率。
summary_zh: 移动机器人通常依赖几何地图进行避障和路径规划，但由此产生的障碍物表征并不总是符合物体对导航影响的实际方式。低矮的线缆可能被忽略，柔性窗帘可能造成虚假的阻挡，而交通锥筒可能需要比其观测足迹更大的排除区域。我们提出了NavPatch，一种物体级别的修正层，通过视觉-语言模型进行周期性场景理解，为导航相关的物体类别分配ADD、REMOVE或EXTEND操作。开放词汇的接地定位识别物体实例，LiDAR和RGB-D观测提供3D支撑。观测质量过滤和跨帧维护决定了每个修正补丁何时被提交、替换或撤销。在五种布局下的50次真实机器人试验中，NavPatch实现了86.0%的总体成功率。对四种配置共200次运行的消融研究表明，与仅基于当前观测的更新相比，NavPatch将成功率从70.0%提高到86.0%，并将误提交率从68.4%降低到40.7%。

title: Learning-Based Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance for a UAV Using Only Three Range Sensors
summary:
We present a learning-based approach to kinodynamic online motion planning for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) operating at a fixed altitude in unknown dynamic environments, where real-time avoidance of both static and dynamic obstacles must be achieved under conditions of extreme partial observability. The UAV is controlled with a single degree of freedom (yaw only), resulting in constrained, nonholonomic motion similar to fixed-wing platforms.
  The proposed framework integrates a behavior grid map representation with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for stable policy learning in continuous control. The key idea is the co-design of a state representation and control policy that enables reliable navigation using only three low-cost directional range sensors, without reliance on dense sensing modalities such as LiDAR or vision-based systems. The behavior grid map dynamically aggregates sparse measurements into a structured local representation that supports real-time decision-making for obstacle avoidance and target reaching. Extensive simulations across environments of varying sizes and obstacle densities demonstrate that the proposed standard and enhanced methods achieve higher success rates than PPO variants and Model Predictive Control (MPC) (94\% vs. 79--90\% in small-scale high-congestion scenarios, and 83\% vs. 62--71\% in large-scale high-congestion scenarios), while maintaining real-time performance. Real-world experiments across four scenarios further confirm practical feasibility, with consistent target-reaching behaviour and no collisions under the tested conditions.
tldr: This paper presents a Deep Reinforcement Learning approach for UAV dynamic obstacle avoidance using only three range sensors, leveraging a behavior grid map for state representation and PPO for policy learning, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的无人机动态避障方法，仅使用三个距离传感器，通过行为网格图进行状态表示和PPO进行策略学习，在仿真和真实世界测试中取得了较高的成功率。
summary_zh:
我们提出了一种基于学习的方法，用于在未知动态环境中以固定高度运行的无人航空器（UAV）的动力学在线运动规划，其中必须在极端部分可观测性条件下实现对静态和动态障碍物的实时规避。该无人航空器仅通过单自由度（仅偏航）进行控制，导致其运动受限于非完整约束，类似于固定翼平台。

所提出的框架将行为网格地图表示与深度强化学习（DRL）相结合，利用近端策略优化（PPO）在连续控制中实现稳定的策略学习。其核心思想是协同设计状态表示与控制策略，使得仅使用三个低成本定向距离传感器即可完成可靠的导航，无需依赖激光雷达或基于视觉的系统等密集传感方式。行为网格地图将稀疏测量值动态聚合为结构化的局部表示，从而支持面向障碍物规避和目标到达的实时决策制定。在多种环境规模及障碍物密度下进行的大量仿真表明，所提出的标准方法和增强方法在成功率上均优于PPO变体及模型预测控制（MPC）（在小规模高拥堵场景中为94%，对比79%–90%；在大规模高拥堵场景中为83%，对比62%–71%），同时保持实时性能。在四种场景下进行的真实世界实验进一步验证了其实用可行性，在测试条件下实现了稳定的目标到达行为且无碰撞发生。

title: Orientation Control of Soft Robots via Adiabatic Spectral Submanifolds
summary: Soft robots are commonly sought for safety-critical interactions in delicate environments, where accurate position and orientation control is imperative. Model predictive control (MPC) offers a solution, but it requires a model of the robot's infinite-dimensional nonlinear dynamics that is at once accurate and computationally cheap. Recent theory on adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) and their applications to soft robots provide data-driven model-reduction methods to construct such models. Here, we extend these methods to identify aSSMs from enlarged observable datasets and upgrade the currently available aSSM-MPC schemes. Evaluated on a high-fidelity finite-element simulation of a pressure-actuated soft arm, our controller reduces position and orientation tracking error by more than 60% compared to existing data-driven baselines.
tldr: This paper enhances model predictive control for soft robots by identifying adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) from enlarged datasets, reducing position and orientation tracking errors by over 60% in simulation compared to data-driven baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文通过从扩展数据集中识别绝热谱子流形（aSSMs），改进了软体机器人的模型预测控制，在仿真中相比数据驱动基线将位置和姿态跟踪误差降低了60%以上。
summary_zh: 软体机器人通常被用于精细环境中的安全关键交互场景，其中精确的位置与姿态控制至关重要。模型预测控制（MPC）提供了一种解决方案，但它需要一种既能保证精度又具备计算效率的模型来描述机器人无限维非线性动力学。近期关于绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）的理论及其在软体机器人中的应用，提供了基于数据驱动的模型降阶方法，以构建此类模型。在此，我们将这些方法扩展，从扩大的可观测数据集中识别aSSMs，并升级当前可用的aSSM-MPC方案。在压力驱动软臂的高保真有限元仿真评估中，与现有数据驱动基线方法相比，我们的控制器将位置与姿态跟踪误差降低了60%以上。

title: Multi-Task Visual Perception Network with LLM Conditioning for Autonomous Navigation
summary: Long-term navigation for service robots faces crit- ical challenges like the accumulation of odometry drift and sensor error, which progressively degrade 2D maps and renders traditional path planning algorithms (e.g., A*, RRT*, DiPPer, ViT-A*) ineffective over time. To address this, we propose a user-friendly, interactive framework that eliminates the reliance on globally consistent maps. Our approach integrates visual perception with Large Language Models (LLM) to interpret user commands via text or voice. Instead of relying on a drift- prone global map, the system generates a sequential action plan based on local visual cues and egocentric geometric instructions. These action plans are executed sequentially, allowing the robot to navigate known and unknown environments safely. By reset- ting localization relative to immediate targets, our framework effectively works with a minimum accumulation drift strategy, ensuring accurate, efficient, and collision-free navigation without the maintenance overhead of traditional mapping. Experiments on real-world and simulated data have shown significant improve- ments over other methods. Our source code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/PraveenSingh24/VL-Navigation.
tldr: This paper presents an interactive navigation framework for service robots that combines visual perception with large language models (LLMs) to interpret user commands and generate sequential, local map-free action plans, aiming to reduce odometry drift and map maintenance issues. The system is tested on real-world and simulated data, showing improvements over traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向服务机器人的交互式导航框架，结合视觉感知和大语言模型（LLM）来理解用户指令并生成基于局部视觉线索的序列化动作规划，以减少里程计漂移和对全局地图的依赖。在真实与仿真数据上的实验表明其优于传统方法。
summary_zh: 服务机器人的长期导航面临关键挑战，如里程计漂移和传感器误差的累积，这些问题会逐渐降低二维地图的质量，并使传统路径规划算法（如A*、RRT*、DiPPer、ViT-A*）随着时间推移而失效。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用户友好的交互式框架，消除了对全局一致地图的依赖。我们的方法将视觉感知与大语言模型（LLM）相结合，通过文本或语音解读用户指令。该系统不依赖易受漂移影响的全局地图，而是基于局部视觉线索和以自我为中心的几何指令生成顺序行动计划。这些行动计划被依次执行，使机器人能够在已知和未知环境中安全导航。通过相对于即时目标重置定位，我们的框架能够以最小累积漂移策略有效工作，确保导航的准确性、高效性和无碰撞性，同时避免传统建图的维护开销。在真实世界和模拟数据上的实验表明，我们的方法相较其他方法有显著改进。我们的源代码公开可获取，网址为 https://github.com/PraveenSingh24/VL-Navigation。

title: Task-Specified Active Metrological Inspection with Measurement-Steered VLA Manipulation and Deterministic Evidence Gating
summary: High-mix low-volume (HMLV) manufacturing requires inspection systems to adapt to changing parts, specifications, and work orders without repeated task-specific programming. Existing inspection automation typically assumes predefined sensing sequences, while general purpose robot agents optimize task completion rather than the completeness and validity of metrological evidence. We formulate task-specified active metrological inspection and propose From Requirements to Admissible Metrological Evidence (FRAME), a hierarchical dual-arm framework that converts an inspection instruction and structured specification into traceable conformance evidence. FRAME coordinates learned manipulation with calibrated laser profilometry: a task manager grounds and schedules requirements, active surface correspondence verifies physical-to-specification localization, and evidence memory tracks measurement provenance, admissibility, and coverage. Learned components may propose inspection targets and physical access actions, but deterministic datum-grounded measurement, admissibility checks, coverage auditing, and conformance evaluation prevent incomplete or unverified evidence from authorizing PASS. A series of physical experiments shows that FRAME achieves higher end-to-end inspection reliability, fewer false accepts, and shorter task completion time.
tldr: FRAME is a hierarchical dual-arm framework for task-specified active metrological inspection, using VLA manipulation with deterministic evidence gating to ensure traceable conformance evidence in high-mix low-volume manufacturing.
tldr_zh: FRAME是一个用于任务指定主动计量检测的分层双臂框架，利用VLA操作与确定性证据门控，在高混合低容量制造中确保可追溯的一致性证据。
summary_zh: 高混合低批量（HMLV）制造要求检测系统能够适应变化的零件、规格和工作订单，而无需重复的任务特定编程。现有检测自动化通常假定预定义的传感序列，而通用机器人的智能体则侧重于任务完成，而非计量证据的完整性和有效性。我们提出了任务指定的主动计量检测方法，并构建了从需求到可接受计量证据的框架（FRAME），这是一个分层双臂框架，可将检测指令和结构化规格转化为可追溯的一致性证据。FRAME将学习操作与校准激光轮廓测量相协调：任务管理器对要求进行落实和调度，主动表面对应验证物理到规格的定位，证据记忆跟踪测量来源、可接受性和覆盖率。学习组件可提出检测目标和物理访问动作，但确定性的基准接地测量、可接受性检查、覆盖审计和一致性评估可防止不完整或未经验证的证据被授权通过。一系列物理实验表明，FRAME实现了更高的端到端检测可靠性、更少的误接受和更短的任务完成时间。

title: Gradient-Free Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Scalable Safety-Critical Control
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability provides a principled framework for synthesizing safety certificates and robust controllers for safety-critical robotic systems. However, applying reachability analysis to high-dimensional nonlinear systems remains challenging: classical grid-based solvers suffer from the curse of dimensionality, continuous-time neural solvers require accurate spatial value gradients, and reinforcement-learning-based approaches often suffer from weak boundary anchoring and non-stationary adversarial policy optimization. We propose a discrete-time neural reachability framework for control-disturbance-affine systems that learns backward reachable tubes (BRTs) and backward reach-avoid tubes (BRATs) through Bellman-Isaacs value propagation. Our key idea is to combine equation-driven self-supervision with structured policy learning: rather than computing explicit PDE-gradients, we exploit the bang-bang structure of optimal safety interventions to construct approximate teacher actions from gradient-free value probes, converting adversarial actor learning into supervised policy learning. To stabilize long-horizon value propagation, we leverage the learned actor to train the value function backward from the terminal boundary using a windowed temporal curriculum, where each window is used as the boundary condition for the next window. Across benchmark problems up to 80 dimensions, our method learns accurate reachability value functions while improving stability over existing learning-based solvers. We further demonstrate observation-space scalability on F1-tenth racing with over 16,000-dimensional egocentric inputs. The learned safety filter generalizes zero-shot to unseen tracks and transfers to a physical RC car, achieving real-time robust collision avoidance.
tldr: This paper introduces a gradient-free, discrete-time neural reachability framework for safety-critical control, learning backward reachable tubes via Bellman-Isaacs value propagation with supervised bang-bang policy learning and a windowed temporal curriculum. It scales to 80-dimensional benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and real-world transfer for F1-tenth racing with real-time collision avoidance on a physical RC car.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无梯度的离散时间神经可达性框架，用于安全关键控制，通过Bellman-Isaacs值传播结合监督式bang-bang策略学习和窗口时间课程学习来学习后向可达管。该方法可扩展到80维基准，并在F1-10赛车上实现了零样本泛化和物理RC车的实时避障。
summary_zh: Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析为安全关键机器人系统的安全证书合成与鲁棒控制器设计提供了 principled 框架。然而，将可达性分析应用于高维非线性系统仍面临诸多挑战：经典的基于网格的求解器受困于维度灾难，连续时间神经求解器需要精确的空间值梯度，而基于强化学习的方法往往存在边界锚定薄弱以及对抗性策略优化非平稳的问题。我们提出了一种面向控制-扰动仿射系统的离散时间神经可达性框架，通过Bellman-Isaacs值传播学习后向可达管（BRTs）和后向可达-避碰管（BRATs）。我们的核心思想是将方程驱动的自监督与结构化策略学习相结合：不显式计算偏微分方程梯度，而是利用最优安全干预的bang-bang结构，通过无梯度值探测构造近似教师动作，从而将对抗性actor学习转化为监督式策略学习。为稳定长时域值传播，我们利用所学actor从终端边界向后训练值函数，并采用窗口化时间课程，其中每个窗口作为下一个窗口的边界条件。在最高达80维的基准测试问题中，我们的方法能够学习精确的可达性值函数，同时在稳定性上优于现有基于学习的求解器。我们进一步在F1十赛车任务中展示了观测空间的可扩展性，其自我中心输入维度超过16,000维。所学安全滤波器可零样本泛化至未见赛道，并成功迁移至实体遥控车，实现实时鲁棒避障。

title: Managing Action Preconditions in Neuro-Symbolic RL: Three Placement Strategies for Embodied Agents
summary: Humans carry behaviour knowledge of how to act in familiar situations into every new task rather than relearning it from scratch. There is no reason a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent shouldn't do the same: known behaviour patterns need not be learned, only applied. Neuro-symbolic RL bridges prior knowledge and RL by injecting symbolic knowledge alongside a learned policy. The point at which this knowledge is integrated is critical: a poor choice can produce, for instance, hallucinated preconditions, which surface as safety and reliability problems in agents acting in changing environments. We formalise this behavioural knowledge as a precondition Bayesian network (BN) over the agent's \emph{structural actions} - the actions whose legality depends on preconditions, such as picking up a key, grasping a block, toggling a door, or dropping an object. The BN restricts when these actions may fire, and we inject it into the RL loop at three placements: (1) a \emph{symbolic verifier}, consulted only at inference, that fires a structural action once its preconditions hold; (2) a \emph{symbolic enforcer}, active during both training and inference, that governs structural-action use throughout learning; and (3) a \emph{symbolic learner}, which folds the knowledge into the network and learns the restriction and use of structural actions itself. To test the three variants we run experiments on two benchmarks with opposite regimes: one built on long, ordered planning chains, the other on continuous manipulation. We compare against strong baselines on solution quality, sample efficiency, and traceability. The payoff is substantial. On MiniGrid, all three placements improve the \emph{solution quality} over the PPO+RND baseline, the symbolic enforcer leading at $98.2\%$ against the baseline's $88.8\%$. On Fetch, $\dots$
tldr: This paper explores three strategies for injecting symbolic knowledge about action preconditions into neuro-symbolic reinforcement learning agents, demonstrating substantial improvements in solution quality and sample efficiency over baselines in embodied agent benchmarks such as MiniGrid and Fetch.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在神经符号强化学习智能体中注入动作前提符号知识的三种策略，并在MiniGrid和Fetch等具身智能基准测试中展示了相较于基线在解决方案质量和样本效率上的显著提升。
summary_zh: 人类会将熟悉情境中的行为知识带入每一个新任务，而不是从头重新学习。强化学习（RL）智能体没有理由不这样做：已知的行为模式无需重新学习，只需加以应用。神经符号强化学习通过将符号知识与学习到的策略相结合，弥合了先验知识与强化学习之间的鸿沟。知识注入的时点至关重要：选择不当可能会产生例如幻觉化前提条件，这在智能体于变化环境中行动时，会表现为安全性和可靠性问题。我们将这种行为知识形式化为一个前提贝叶斯网络（BN），该网络建立在智能体的\emph{结构动作}之上——这些动作的合法性取决于前提条件，例如拾取钥匙、抓取积木、切换门或放下物体。该贝叶斯网络限制了这些动作何时可以触发，我们将其注入强化学习循环中的三个位置：（1）\emph{符号验证器}，仅在推理时调用，一旦前提条件满足即触发结构动作；（2）\emph{符号执行器}，在训练和推理期间均处于活动状态，在整个学习过程中控制结构动作的使用；（3）\emph{符号学习器}，将知识纳入网络，并自主学习结构动作的限制与使用。为测试这三种变体，我们在两种具有相反机制的基准上进行了实验：一种基于长序列、有序的规划链，另一种基于连续操作。我们在解质量、样本效率和可追溯性方面与强基线进行了比较。收益显著。在MiniGrid上，所有三种注入位置都相较PPO+RND基线提高了\emph{解质量}，其中符号执行器表现最佳，达到$98.2\%$，而基线为$88.8\%$。在Fetch上，$\dots$

title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
summary: Interactive video world models must maintain broad scene context under camera motion while producing high-fidelity observations with low latency. Existing approaches face a representation trade-off: perspective models operate on local views and must preserve off-screen content over long rollouts, whereas broader spatial coverage is typically obtained by synthesizing full-sphere videos or constructing explicit 3D representations. Motivated by the complementary roles of global context and selective local acuity in visual perception, we present AlayaVista, a camera-controllable streaming video world model that decouples panoramic world evolution from perspective observation synthesis. Given a single perspective image, AlayaVista constructs a 360-degree scene prior using a pretrained panorama expansion model and then evolves the scene as a camera-conditioned panoramic latent state. A latent viewport renderer maps this state to the requested perspective video latents, while a perspective refiner restores details, suppresses artifacts, and performs super-resolution. To support efficient streaming, we adapt the panoramic generator to chunk-autoregressive generation and distill both panoramic generation and perspective refinement into few-step processes. To provide the supervision required by this design, we construct MUGEN, a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset containing 1,318 hours of videos at resolutions of at least 4K, together with rich semantic and geometric annotations.
tldr: AlayaVista presents a camera-controllable streaming video world model that decouples global panoramic world evolution from perspective view synthesis, using a panoramic latent state and a viewport renderer for efficient high-fidelity video generation with low latency.
tldr_zh: AlayaVista 提出了一种相机可控的流式视频世界模型，将全景世界演化与视角图像合成解耦，通过全景潜状态和视口渲染器实现高效低延迟的高保真视频生成。
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型必须在相机运动下保持广泛的场景上下文，同时以低延迟生成高保真观测。现有方法面临一种表示上的权衡：透视模型基于局部视图进行操作，在长程推演中必须保留屏幕外内容，而更广泛的空间覆盖通常通过合成全景视频或构建显式三维表示来实现。受全局上下文与选择性局部锐度在视觉感知中互补作用的启发，我们提出了AlayaVista，一种相机可控的流式视频世界模型，将全景世界演化与透视观测合成解耦。给定单张透视图像，AlayaVista利用预训练的全景扩展模型构建360度场景先验，随后将场景演化为以相机为条件的全景潜在状态。一个潜在视口渲染器将该状态映射为所请求的透视视频潜在表示，而透视细化器则用于恢复细节、抑制伪影并进行超分辨率处理。为支持高效流式生成，我们将全景生成器适配为分块自回归生成，并将全景生成与透视细化均蒸馏为少步过程。为提供该设计所需的监督信号，我们构建了MUGEN，一个大规模真实世界全景视频数据集，包含1，318小时分辨率不低于4K的视频，并配有丰富的语义与几何标注。

title: Language-Grounded Semantic Target Navigation for Autonomous Surface Vehicles
summary: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) are increasingly expected to operate in ports and harbour environments, where operators may specify navigation targets through language-based descriptions rather than predefined coordinates or fixed target identifiers. However, existing ASV navigation methods mainly execute predefined geometric goals or task-specific objectives and give limited attention to language-grounded target specification. This study proposes Semantically Grounded Navigation (SGNav), a framework that enables an ASV to identify and approach a maritime target from an operator-provided description. SGNav integrates text-guided semantic grounding, harbour-aware candidate filtering, CLIP-based semantic verification, grounded target control-state construction, and Proximal Policy Optimisation-based closed-loop control. It grounds the target description in onboard RGB observations, suppresses visually or semantically irrelevant distractors, and converts the selected target into a compact control-oriented representation for policy execution. Experiments in simulated port environments show that SGNav achieves success rates of $97.0\pm1.2\%$, $92.0\pm1.5\%$, and $90.0\pm1.8\%$ across three representative target-reaching tasks, with semantic target accuracy above $97\%$ and wrong-target rates below $3\%$. SGNav also maintains $97.7$--$98.7\%$ success rates across held-out port layouts. In the Task~3 ablation study, removing harbour-aware filtering or semantic consistency reduces the success rate to $40.4\pm2.6\%$ and $50.4\pm3.1\%$, respectively. These findings demonstrate the importance of semantic grounding, harbour-aware filtering, and semantic verification for reliable language-grounded ASV navigation. These results indicate that the proposed perception-to-control framework can support language-grounded target approach manoeuvres of ASV under the complex port environments.
tldr: This paper introduces SGNav, a framework for language-grounded semantic target navigation for Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs), integrating text-guided semantic grounding, harbour-aware filtering, CLIP-based verification, and PPO-based closed-loop control, achieving high success rates in simulated port environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SGNav框架，用于自主水面车辆（ASV）的语言引导语义目标导航，集成了文本引导的语义定位、港口感知过滤、基于CLIP的语义验证和基于PPO的闭环控制，在模拟港口环境中实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 自主水面艇（ASV）在港口和港湾环境中作业的需求日益增长，操作人员可能通过基于语言的描述来指定航行目标，而非预定义的坐标或固定的目标标识。然而，现有的ASV导航方法主要执行预定义的几何目标或特定任务目标，对基于语言的目标指定的关注有限。本研究提出了语义接地导航（SGNav）框架，使ASV能够根据操作人员提供的描述识别并接近海上目标。SGNav集成了文本引导的语义接地、港口感知候选筛选、基于CLIP的语义验证、接地目标控制状态构建以及基于近端策略优化的闭环控制。该框架将目标描述与机载RGB观测进行接地，抑制视觉或语义上不相关的干扰物，并将选定目标转换为紧凑的控制导向表示用于策略执行。在模拟港口环境中的实验表明，SGNav在三个代表性目标接近任务中的成功率分别为$97.0\pm1.2\%$、$92.0\pm1.5\%$和$90.0\pm1.8\%$，语义目标准确率高于$97\%$，错误目标率低于$3\%$。SGNav在未见过的港口布局中仍保持$97.7$--$98.7\%$的成功率。在Task~3消融研究中，移除港口感知筛选或语义一致性分别将成功率降至$40.4\pm2.6\%$和$50.4\pm3.1\%$。这些发现证明了语义接地、港口感知筛选和语义验证对于可靠的语言接地ASV导航的重要性。结果表明，所提出的感知-控制框架能够在复杂港口环境下支持ASV的语言接地目标接近机动。

title: Bi-Level Routing and Sparse Spatial Attention based Multi-View BEV 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Bird's Eye View (BEV)-based multi-view 3D object detection suffers from challenges of computational complexity, multi-scale feature extraction, and efficiency of dense 2D-to-BEV view transformation. To address these problems, this paper proposes an improved BEV 3D object detection algorithm Sparse-BEVNet. Firstly, a Bi-Level Routing Attention (BRA) mechanism is introduced into the image feature extraction network to reduce the computational burden of the backbone. Second, Cascaded Group Attention (CGA) is employed in the feature fusion module, which enhances deep interaction across features of different hierarchical levels without introducing additional computational overhead. Furthermore, a Sparse Spatial Cross-Attention mechanism is adopted to replace the conventional dense view projection pipeline. Experimental results on the public nuScenes dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 45.2% and a nuScenes Detection Score (NDS) of 54.5%, corresponding to 3.6% and 2.8% improvements relative to the baseline model, respectively.
tldr: This paper proposes Sparse-BEVNet, an improved BEV-based multi-view 3D object detection method for autonomous driving, incorporating a Bi-Level Routing Attention mechanism, Cascaded Group Attention, and Sparse Spatial Cross-Attention to reduce computational burden and enhance multi-scale feature extraction, achieving improved mAP and NDS on the nuScenes dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Sparse-BEVNet，一种用于自动驾驶的改进BEV多视图三维目标检测方法，通过引入双层级路由注意力、级联组注意力和稀疏空间交叉注意力来降低计算负担并增强多尺度特征提取，在nuScenes数据集上取得了mAP和NDS的提升。
summary_zh: 基于鸟瞰视角的多视角三维目标检测面临着计算复杂度高、多尺度特征提取困难以及稠密二维到鸟瞰视角变换效率低下等挑战。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种改进的鸟瞰视角三维目标检测算法Sparse-BEVNet。首先，在图像特征提取网络中引入双层路由注意力机制，以降低骨干网络的计算负担。其次，在特征融合模块中采用级联分组注意力，在不增加额外计算开销的情况下，增强不同层级特征之间的深层交互。此外，采用稀疏空间交叉注意力机制替代传统的稠密视角投影流程。在公开的nuScenes数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法实现了45.2%的平均精度和54.5%的nuScenes检测得分，相较于基线模型分别提升了3.6%和2.8%。

title: AssemblyGrid v1: A Benchmark for Multi-Robot Production with Temporary Coalitions, Local Information, and Geometric Constraints
summary: Flexible robotic production requires joint decisions on process progression, material routing, resource assignment, temporary cooperation, and simultaneous execution, since each decision can affect the feasibility of the others. The challenge is greater under decentralized control, where each robot acts from bounded local information while system progress depends on collective decisions, shared resources, material state, and workspace compatibility. These properties closely match cooperative multi-agent decision making under partial observability and resource contention. This paper introduces AssemblyGrid v1, a reproducible benchmark for repeated multi-robot production that combines explicit process progression, decentralized observations, material transfer, temporary multi-robot coalitions, productive concurrency, and geometry-dependent feasibility within one task-level formulation. The benchmark includes Flow, Coalition, and Concurrency workload families, each with three scenario levels. Task success and evaluation measures are defined independently of learning reward and solution method, allowing learning-based and non-learning methods to address the same production problem. AssemblyGrid v1 is evaluated through executable conformance checks, mechanism studies, and algorithmic experiments using a privileged centralized reference, structured decentralized controllers, and MARL methods including IPPO, MAPPO, and QMIX. Results demonstrate productive execution under centralized and decentralized control. The MARL experiments further show that decentralized policies can learn effective production behavior from local observations and actions, supporting AssemblyGrid as a controlled benchmark for studying cooperative decision making in flexible robotic production.
tldr: AssemblyGrid v1 is a benchmark for multi-robot production that combines decentralized control, temporary coalitions, and geometric constraints in a task-level formulation, with centralized and decentralized controllers as well as MARL methods evaluated on it.
tldr_zh: AssemblyGrid v1 是一个多机器人生产基准，结合了分散控制、临时联盟和几何约束的任务级公式，并对其评估了集中式和分散式控制器及多智能体强化学习方法。

title: Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World
summary: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language semantics and motion dynamics. Open-UniMo is trained with a two-stage pipeline, where supervised fine-tuning establishes CoT-guided bidirectional motion-language mapping and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves semantic alignment while mitigating cumulative errors in autoregressive motion-token generation. To support comprehensive evaluation, we propose Open-MoBench, a VLM-guided benchmark for assessing text-to-motion (T2M) generation, motion-to-text (M2T) understanding, and bidirectional consistency. Extensive experiments show that Open-UniMo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both conventional metrics and Open-MoBench. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that M2T understanding is not primarily limited by motion-token vocabulary size; instead, coupling M2T with the learnable T2M generation path yields stronger cross-modal representations, demonstrating that generation can facilitate understanding in AR-based motion-language modeling.
tldr: Open-UniMo unifies motion-language understanding and generation in a large motion-language model with shared token space and chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving SOTA performance on generated and conventional benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Open-UniMo通过共享token空间和思维链推理统一运动-语言理解与生成，在常规和生成的基准上达到最优性能。

title: Schema-Adaptive Action-Conditioned JEPA for Cross-Machine CNC Transfer under Partial Sensor Overlap
summary: Cross-machine deployment of industrial world models requires transfer across changes in dynamics, sensing interfaces, sampling regimes, and control units. We study a schema-adaptive action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (SAAC-JEPA) for CNC dynamics, where the source machine has 17 canonical sensor channels and the target shares only 10. Evaluation uses group-disjoint source splits, source-only normalization, held-out self-supervised validation, unit audits, and a sealed target test after model locking. Across five seeds, JEPA pretraining gives no clean-source forecasting gain: scratch and pretrained-body models obtain \(\mathrm{RMSE}=0.811\pm0.022\) and \(0.813\pm0.022\). A source-only search over 20 candidates selects a schema-consistent action-conditioned JEPA after seven-seed stability checks. On the confirmatory target pass, the locked model reaches zero-shot \(\mathrm{RMSE}=0.546\), \(R^2=0.012\), and \(\mathrm{NLL}=0.52\), outperforming persistence but not RevIN-equipped PatchTST and iTransformer baselines (\(0.503\) and \(0.498\)). A pre-declared paired ablation shows that RevIN in the same architecture improves RMSE to \(0.495\pm0.004\) over three seeds, but degrades target calibration (\(\mathrm{NLL}=20.6\)) on stationary context windows. A pre-lock adaptation sweep further reduces RMSE to \(0.520\) with limited target support. These results show that source-domain forecasting accuracy alone is insufficient to assess industrial predictive representations, and that cross-machine adaptation under partial sensor overlap is a distinct evaluation axis.
tldr: This paper proposes SAAC-JEPA, a schema-adaptive action-conditioned JEPA model for cross-machine CNC dynamics transfer under partial sensor overlap, showing that source-domain forecasting accuracy alone is insufficient for industrial predictive representations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SAAC-JEPA，一种用于部分传感器重叠下跨机器CNC动力学迁移的模式自适应动作条件JEPA模型，表明源域预测精度不足以评估工业预测表示。

title: Fault Diagnosis for Underwater Vehicles using Moving Horizon Estimation and Gaussian Processes
summary: This work proposes a model-based fault detection and diagnosis framework for underwater vehicles subject to actuator faults that explicitly accounts for the presence of unmodeled dynamics. To this end, a Moving Horizon Estimator (MHE) is developed to estimate the lumped disturbance, capturing both unmodeled and fault effects. Gaussian Processes (GPs) are employed to approximate the unmodeled dynamics, providing predictions of the corresponding mean and uncertainty across diverse operating conditions. During online operation, the residual between the MHE lumped disturbance estimate and the GP prediction is evaluated using a Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test. By incorporating GP-based predictions within the diagnostic framework, robustness to unmodeled dynamics is achieved, enabling effective fault detection and isolation as well as accurate quantitative estimation of fault magnitude. The proposed methodology is experimentally validated in a laboratory water tank, demonstrating reliable diagnostic performance under both open-loop and closed-loop control.
tldr: This paper proposes a fault detection and diagnosis framework for underwater vehicles using Moving Horizon Estimation combined with Gaussian Processes to handle unmodeled dynamics, validated in a laboratory water tank.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种水下机器人故障检测与诊断框架，利用移动时域估计和高斯过程处理未建模动态，并在实验室水槽中进行了验证。

title: DynEoMT: Learning Object Dynamicity from Online Segmentation Queries
summary: Video segmentation models recognize and track objects over time, but they do not indicate whether each segmented region moves independently of the observing camera. This dynamicity attribute cannot be inferred from semantics alone and is confounded by camera ego-motion. We introduce \method, an online framework that augments query-based video segmentation with region-level dynamicity prediction. It jointly produces the original segmentation outputs and a dynamic or static state for each predicted region. At inference, DynEoMT uses only the current frame and propagated queries, without optical flow, depth, camera pose, previous RGB frames, or feature maps. Because established video segmentation benchmarks do not annotate this attribute, we also introduce a class-agnostic offline supervision pipeline using camera-compensated optical flow and confidence-aware temporal filtering. Across VIPSeg, OVIS, YouTube-VIS 2022, and VSPW, DynEoMT achieves balanced accuracies of 84.3, 68.0, 68.6, and 87.6, respectively, while largely preserving segmentation performance. These results show that segmentation-region dynamicity can be learned from propagated queries, enabling its online prediction without a dedicated motion-processing pipeline at inference. The complete code will be released as open source to enable full reproduction of the method and experiments.
tldr: DynEoMT augments query-based video segmentation with online region-level dynamicity prediction (static/dynamic), using only the current frame and propagated queries at inference, and introduces a camera-compensated optical-flow supervision pipeline to train it without dedicated motion input.
tldr_zh: DynEoMT 通过在线查询传播为视频分割结果添加区域级动态性预测（静态/动态），推理时仅需当前帧和传播的查询，并利用相机补偿光流监督管线进行训练，无需专门的光流、深度或位姿输入。

title: Embracing Flow Unsteadiness: A High-Throughput Learning Platform Enables Vortex-Exploiting Bioinspired Propulsion
summary: Biological swimmers and flyers exploit unsteady vortices for propulsion, whereas engineered vehicles usually suppress them as disturbances. Learning such flow exploitation in machines is difficult because real-fluid interaction data are scarce and unstructured exploration is unstable in high-dimensional, history-dependent flows. Here we present REEF, a co-designed physical-learning framework that integrates SHOAL, an eight-channel high-throughput array for real fluid--structure interaction, with V-STAR, a staged algorithm that converts these interactions into policies through imitation, offline internalization, and online adaptation. Across lift-based, drag-based, and momentum-jet propulsors, REEF expands the attainable force envelope to more than twice that of parameterized search. Particle image velocimetry shows that these gains arise from coordinated vortex formation, growth, and force projection, rather than refinement of a fixed motion-to-force mapping. Force-trained policies transfer zero-shot to free-moving robots whose body motion changes the surrounding flow, suggesting that REEF learns transferable wake-coupling principles for embodied propulsion in unsteady fluids.
tldr: The paper presents REEF, a physical-learning platform with an eight-channel fluid-structure interaction array and a staged algorithm, to learn bioinspired propulsion policies that exploit unsteady vortices, expanding force envelopes and transferring zero-shot to free-moving robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出REEF，一个结合八通道流固耦合实验平台与分阶段算法的物理学习框架，用于学习利用非定常涡旋的生物推进策略，扩大推力包络并零样本迁移到自由移动机器人。

title: DreamSat-Bench: Development and Initial Testing of a Testbed for AI-Based Pose Estimation from 3D Reconstruction
summary: This paper presents the development and initial testing of DreamSat-Bench, a modular rendezvous and proximity operation testbed designed to benchmark AI-based relative navigation techniques. By integrating a software- and hardware-in-the-loop robotic pipeline, the platform enables a seamless transition from digital simulation to physical reality. DreamSat-Bench unifies state-of-the-art robotic learning tools such as MuJoCo, Isaac Lab, and LeRobot into a single benchmarking platform, utilizing robotic arms to trace 3D trajectories. The platform allows for extensive customization of orbital environments and lighting to evaluate the simulation-to-reality gap. We demonstrate the testbed's utility by evaluating an end-to-end vision-based navigation pipeline that pairs DreamSat, a generative AI framework for single-view 3D reconstruction, with FoundationPose for zero-shot 6-DoF tracking of unseen spacecraft. Initial testing explores mission-representative orbital segments, including fixed-point station-keeping and fly-around characterization. Through a series of parametric studies, we quantify the impacts of reconstruction latency, mesh resolution, orbital range, and illumination geometry on pose estimation accuracy. Finally, a preliminary hardware-in-the-loop campaign qualitatively validates the physical deployment of the pipeline, identifying target symmetry and accumulated tracking drift as critical factors for robust navigation. DreamSat-Bench provides a rigorous framework for maturing autonomous navigation with unprepared space assets in the absence of prior geometric models.
tldr: DreamSat-Bench is a testbed for benchmarking AI-based pose estimation for spacecraft rendezvous, integrating simulation and hardware with a generative 3D reconstruction and 6-DoF tracking pipeline.
tldr_zh: DreamSat-Bench是一个用于基准测试航天器交会中基于AI的姿态估计的测试平台，集成了仿真和硬件，并采用生成式3D重建和6自由度跟踪流程。

title: EcoBoat: Design and Experimental Validation of an Autonomous Body-Board Boat For Cleaning Water Bodies
summary: Cleaning water bodies such as swimming pools and lakes typically demands significant manual effort or reliance on costly, sensor-intensive robotic systems. This paper presents EcoBoat, a low-cost autonomous surface vehicle built on a modified hull, designed to collect floating debris in both indoor and outdoor water bodies. For indoor environments, EcoBoat uses ultrasonic sensors to detect boundaries and obstacles, combining random-walk motion with boundary-following behavior. For outdoor environments, it relies on GPS-based geofencing paired with a random-walk strategy for area coverage. A key design feature is a Tesla-valve-inspired collection basket that allows debris intake during forward motion while preventing its escape during turning or braking. Field experiments in pools and lakes validated the design through iterative refinement, demonstrating that a minimalist sensing and computation approach can achieve effective, versatile debris collection across diverse water bodies.
tldr: EcoBoat is a low-cost autonomous surface vehicle for cleaning water bodies, using minimalist sensing (ultrasonic/GPS) and random-walk strategies, validated in pools and lakes.
tldr_zh: EcoBoat 是一种低成本自主水面清洁船，采用极简传感（超声波/GPS）与随机游走策略，并在泳池和湖泊中完成验证。

title: S3-Tracker: Self-Supervised Surgical Tissue Tracking With Contrastive Random Walks
summary: Robust point tracking in endoscopic videos is essential for computer-assisted intervention and autonomous robotic surgery, enabling continuous registration between intraoperative video and preoperative imaging despite soft tissue deformation. However, supervised tracking methods depend on large annotated datasets, while surgical conditions make reliable trajectory annotation challenging. We propose a self-supervised Track-Any-Point approach that learns from unlabeled surgical videos by establishing global pixel correspondences and inferring point trajectories through contrastive random walks. Trained without annotations, our method achieves performance comparable to existing semi-supervised approaches while implicitly handling tissue deformation. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of self-supervised point tracking in surgical environments and its potential to reduce reliance on annotated data.
tldr: S3-Tracker proposes a self-supervised Track-Any-Point method for surgical videos using contrastive random walks, achieving performance comparable to semi-supervised approaches without requiring annotated data.
tldr_zh: S3-Tracker提出了一种基于对比随机游走的自监督手术视频点追踪方法，无需标注数据即可达到与半监督方法相当的性能。

title: ITA-LaCAM: A Complete and Scalable TAPF Solver via Assignment-Aware Configuration-Space Search
summary: Combined Target Assignment and Path Finding (TAPF) requires assigning targets for agents while simultaneously planning collision-free paths. We present ITA-LaCAM, a complete and scalable TAPF solver inspired by LaCAM and ITA-CBS. In ITA-LaCAM, each joint-configuration node carries an agent-to-target matching.
